input.question: q-C-07
input.text: Do pricing exceptions have to be documented?

clauses.text: Pricing exceptions may be documented in the loan file after closing if time is short.
clauses.title: Documenting Pricing Exceptions

clauses.text: Every pricing exception must be documented in the loan file with the reason and the approver.
clauses.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-22: Documenting pricing exceptions

clauses.text: Every pricing exception must be documented in the loan file with the reason and the approver.
clauses.title: Rate Exception Authority Card
